audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Aurora/Skill/Yasuo/Yasuo/Aurora/Yasuo/Yasuo while this page's own whys said the opposite: whys[1] 'Level 2 still favours Aurora', whys[2] 'At 3 her poke plus W blink keeps her ahead', whys[6] 'Late it evens to a skill matchup'. Three rows rendered one answer in the chart and another in the text.
audit.why: Twofold Hex is a 900-range missile against Yasuo's 475 Q, and Across the Veil (22s at rank 1) blinks her out of the E-Q engage, so levels 2 and 3 are hers; late the lane genuinely evens out between her poke and his crit burst.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 2, 3 read Aurora; Levels 4-5 Yasuo; Level 6 Aurora; First item Yasuo; 2+ items Skill. Matches the packet chart exactly. Rows proposed as a matched full+content group.

audit.why: Spike windows are right — Aurora 3-5, her level 6, Yasuo's first crit item, then an even late game. Level 2 and 3 phase text was generic filler claiming Yasuo mobility he does not have yet, so both were rewritten with real numbers.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why and phases[2].why now give the 900 Q range and Across the Veil's 22s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated/misassigned ability names ran through the page. spikes[0] called her E 'Across the Sanctum' — no such ability. Five places (spikes[1], whys[4], mid, wants.foe[1], and by implication the level-6 read) called her ULTIMATE 'The Weirding', which is actually her E. Four places called The Weirding a stun. breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t described Twofold Hex as 'Her escape' and tagged it '(Blink)'.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Spirit Abjuration (P), Twofold Hex (Q), Across the Veil (W), The Weirding (E), Between Worlds (R). The Weirding damages and slows — Riot's text says slow, not stun; the kit flags agree (slow, zone, no hardCC). The blink/escape is Across the Veil. Twofold Hex is her 900-range projectile poke on 9s at rank 1 — the thing Wind Wall actually eats.
audit.corrected: E named The Weirding and described as a slow; R named Between Worlds; Twofold Hex described as 9s poke you wall rather than an escape; the escape credited to Across the Veil. Also added Spirit Abjuration's healing and the Executioner's Calling answer.
